## Why Top Talent Chooses Gushwork

- ### Health Comes First


Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you, your spouse, dependent children, and even parents.

- ### We've Got Your Back


Personal accident insurance to ensure financial security and peace of mind during unforeseen events.

- ### Pet-Friendly Workplace


A welcoming environment where your pets are part of the team—whether in the office or on video calls.

- ### Grow Fast. Get Recognized.


We foster a culture of ownership, where contributions are acknowledged and growth is both fast and merit-driven.

- ### Flexible Work Hours


We trust you to manage your time effectively—with flexibility and protected hours for deep, focused work.

- ### Performance-Based Rewards


Compensation grows with your skills and impact—supported by a culture of recognition and regular team celebrations.

- ### Team Offsites


Regular trips to build real relationships and plan the future. Work on big problems together, then explore new places.

- ### Best-in-Class Tools


Top hardware and any software subscriptions you need to do your best work.

- ### Real Ownership


Your projects, your decisions, your impact. No micromanagement or endless approval chains.


...and many more.

[Let's Build Together (opens Lever in a new tab)](https://jobs.lever.co/gushwork/)

## Our Operating Principles

These principles guide how we make decisions, work together, and build technology that democratizes enterprise tools for millions of businesses.

- ### Grow or Die


We're always learning something new. Whether it's a technical skill, understanding our customers better, or improving how we work—growth never stops here.

- ### Process Over Outcome


Good outcomes come from good processes. We focus on doing things right, trusting that the results will follow when we stick to proven methods.

- ### Strong Opinions, Loosely Held


Speak up with conviction regardless of your role or seniority. Listen to others with the same respect. Change your mind when the data proves you wrong.

- ### Customers Over Everything


Our customers' success is our success. We'll go the extra mile, work weekends, and move mountains to help them compete and grow their businesses.

- ### No Bad Customers, Only Bad Products


When customers struggle, we look at our product first. We take responsibility for making our tools clearer, more intuitive, and more valuable.


## From Day One to Great Place to Work®

No corporate theater, no micromanagement, no meaningless meetings. Just people building technology that matters, with the freedom to do their best work. New joiners become advocates within weeks.

People get real ownership over meaningful work, direct access to leadership, and the freedom to solve problems without endless approvals. When your team starts recruiting their own networks, you know you're doing something right. Turns out that makes for a pretty Great Place to Work®.
